description: Why join #403 Quarks? I have a clear vision to build an interactive space exploration game for the NASA Space Apps Challenge! As a NASA Open Science 101 certified lead, I provide a solid scientific framework while remaining open to your creative input. Looking  for artist and designers in pixel art.
summary: Project Quarks is an interactive digital tool designed to identify, analyze, and compare terrestrial analog environments on Earth that share extreme geophysical, climatic, and mineralogical similarities with Mars. By aggregating geological and atmospheric data, our platform allows researchers and space enthusiasts to explore locations like extreme deserts, volcanic regions, and permafrost zones that serve as terrestrial testbeds for planetary science. This project addresses the challenge of understanding Martian habitability and geology by leveraging Earth-bound analogs, reducing the complexity of extraterrestrial research. It is crucial because studying these environments accelerates the development of astrobiological instruments, rover testing protocols, and crewed mission simulations, bridging the gap between Earth exploration and Martian discovery.
details: This project uses real data from NASA and other space agencies to search for and obtain information about different parts of the Earth that have conditions similar to the moon o Mars.
